visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a bright, modern living room with a neutral-colored sofa and a white toy kitchen set. A toddler girl with pigtails, wearing a beige jacket and brown pants, is sitting on the floor. On a wooden coffee table in front of her are several green and pink boxes with cartoon illustrations. (2) The girl picks up a box and a pink pouch, looking down at them intently while her hands explore the packaging. The background shows a large window with white blinds and green foliage visible outside. (3) The toddler interacts with a woman whose hands and lower body are visible. They handle clear plastic cups and pink pouches. Another slightly older girl with similar pigtails, wearing a beige top and brown overalls, enters and sits at the table. (4) The scene transitions to the three individuals sitting around the circular wooden table. The adult pours amber-colored liquid from a pouch into a small cup for the younger girl. Both children have their eyes wide and are focused on the table. (5) The girls hold their cups and clink them together. The younger toddler drinks from her cup using a straw, then later tilts the glass directly to drink. She has liquid residue around her mouth. (6) The video concludes with a full-screen graphic on a light pink background, featuring a cartoon illustration of a girl holding a fruit and brand text at the bottom.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Two young girls with dark hair tied in pigtails. The younger one wears a beige jacket with a white fleece collar; the older one wears brown overalls over a beige shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, well-lit home interior featuring a light-colored sofa, a wooden circular coffee table, and a white play kitchen for children. Large windows with blinds provide natural light.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody and a steady drum beat. A young girl's high-pitched voice is heard speaking Mandarin with an excited tone. Ambient room tone is very low. (2) Percussive thuds and rustling sounds occur as objects are moved. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. The girl's voice repeats a phrase with rising volume and pitch, indicating strong persistence or excitement. (3) A second child's juvenile voice joins, and an adult female voice enters with a warm, patient tone. The BGM remains constant as they converse. (4) Distinct 'clink' sound effects simulate glasses touching, followed by high-pitched vocalizations of delight from the children. A comical 'cartoon bounce' SFX emphasizes a playful moment. (5) Sounds of slurping through a straw are captured clearly. The adult's voice maintains moderate conversational loudness with a friendly intonation. The BGM continues its upbeat major-key melody. (6) The music reaches a natural resolution, fading out as a final 'ding' chime sound underscores the brand graphic.
